label: Pi-Hub Cloud Bridge
info: Working Pi-Hub bridge. Configure tab env values from the Pi UI /integrations. HTTP nodes intentionally use method=use, url empty, authType empty so msg.url/msg.headers are honored. Trace: set TRACE_MODE=off|errors|full to control the Trace/Debug branch; every request carries x-request-id and the cloud echoes it back as rid. Dual-Sink: mit LOCAL_SINK=on geht jeder Push zusaetzlich an die lokale Pi-Hub App (LOCAL_BASE_URL) — Events, Live-Ticks, Command-Results und Traces. Dort werden sie 48h gespeichert und im Pump-Debug-Panel angezeigt.

name: Set these environment values on the tab/group before deploy
Use CLOUD_DEVICE_TOKEN from Pi-Hub /integrations — not factory/reset/revocation token
info: Do not enable the HTTP node's built-in Bearer Auth. This flow sets Authorization in msg.headers. If token is empty it will stop locally instead of spamming 401.

info: Wire your Tibber/Weather/Pump/System metric nodes into Event In. Use component names weather_dwd, tibber_pulse, pump_guard, pump_control, system_stats so cloud charts, voice-intents (pump.status/system.status/energy.price_now) and AI reasoning can find them. Read-only Telegram + Alexa intents read device_state_latest — make sure metrics flow into cloud events so those replies stay fresh without extra polling.

name: WebSocket-Kommandokanal (primär) — Bootstrap: GET /api/public/agent/realtime
info:
Hole CLOUD_WS_URL und CLOUD_DEVICE_ID einmalig ueber den Bootstrap-Endpoint (Bearer CLOUD_DEVICE_TOKEN).
CLOUD_WS_URL = wss://<supabase-url ohne https>/realtime/v1/websocket?apikey=<supabaseKey>&vsn=1.0.0
Kanal = commands:<deviceId>. Kommandos kommen als broadcast-Event 'wake' mit vollem Payload an.
Der 15-Minuten-Poll bleibt nur als Safety-Net.

info: Sendet CPU/RAM/Disk/Temp/Uptime alle 60s an den Live-Relay. Die Cloud broadcastet sie sofort und spiegelt sie max. 1x/5min in device_state_latest — so bleiben die Gauges gefüllt, ohne die DB pro Tick zu wecken.

command: read -r _c a b c pidle _r < /proc/stat; ptot=$((a+b+c+pidle)); sleep 1; read -r _c a b c idle _r < /proc/stat; tot=$((a+b+c+idle)); d=$((tot-ptot)); if [ "$d" -le 0 ]; then cpu=0; else cpu=$(( (100*(d-(idle-pidle)))/d )); fi; mem=$(free | awk '/Mem:/{printf "%.1f", $3/$2*100}'); swap=$(free | awk '/Swap:/{if($2>0) printf "%.1f", $3/$2*100; else printf "0"}'); disk=$(df -P / | awk 'NR==2{gsub("%","",$5); print $5}'); temp=$(cat /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp 2>/dev/null | awk '{printf "%.1f", $1/1000}'); [ -z "$temp" ] && temp=null; up=$(awk '{printf "%d", $1}' /proc/uptime); printf '{"cpu_pct":%s,"mem_pct":%s,"swap_pct":%s,"disk_pct":%s,"temp_c":%s,"uptime_s":%s}' "$cpu" "$mem" "$swap" "$disk" "$temp" "$up"
